name: YouTube Music
description: Reads public YouTube Music playlists and albums and edits your own playlists without an API key or Premium.

settings.label: YouTube Music Web Account
settings.help: Sign in to edit playlists that you own back to YouTube Music (Free or Premium) and read private playlists. If Google blocks embedded login, import from your browser or paste your Cookie header from music.youtube.com.
